name: round-trip-actor
description: A single actor with 10 SOL buys 1 SOL and immediately sells all, repeatedly, until graduation or until 60 SOL of cumulative fees are paid (cap 20,000 round trips).
findings: Round trips: 290. Status: active. Paired lifetime 3.754053 SOL of 100.000000 SOL target; hardened bands 2 of 10.
Actor started with 10 SOL, ends with 0.098724 SOL SOL and 0 POP. Gross capital recycled through buys: 255.373978 SOL. Net quote P/L -9.901276 SOL.

Quote-side fees paid by the actor: 5.107479 SOL (plus base-side fees on every sell). Maturity is a function of paid fees, so a single actor can manufacture it at the cost of ~2% per side per round trip plus rounding; graduation must not be marketed as proof of organic demand.
Average paired quote per 1 SOL round trip: 0.012945 SOL. At that rate the 100 SOL target needs about 7725 round trips (~309 SOL of fees if sized at 1 SOL).
